gflops_note: GFLOPs at imgsz 640 for this repo's single-class model (nc=1). Computed offline with ultralytics.utils.torch_utils.get_flops; it reproduces the value read off the committed yolov8s best.pt (28.6) and matches Ultralytics' published nc=80 figure for that size. The nc=80 published values are n 8.7 / s 28.6 / m 78.9 / l 165.1 / x 257.8.
